name: Bohemian Club
note: notable.ts bohemianClub_624_Taylor (2026-10-15, docs/sf-batches/MODEL-BOHEMIAN.md): six-storey red-brick block, ivy patches on Taylor and Post, arched entrance on Taylor, flags at the Post/Taylor roof corner. Replaces the grey edwardian-terracotta recipe.

name: Whittier Mansion
note: whittierMansion_2090_Jackson (2026-10-15, docs/sf-batches/MODEL-WHITTIER.md): 1896 Swain mansion, ochre walls, red-brown sandstone corner turrets, gabled porch front on Jackson (south). Was an edwardian-terracotta office recipe.

name: Golden Gate Park Carousel
note: strawberry-hill.ts (2026-10-05, Commons 'Golden Gate Park carousel building 01.jpg'): cream rotunda, fluted columns, glazed bays, low ribbed metal dome. Was a midcentury-slab recipe.

name: East Ping Yuen
note: 1951 public housing on Pacific Avenue (Mapillary 2026-10-16, docs/shots/refs/notable/ping-yuen): white walls with a red-and-green Chinese-patterned band over a green-painted ground floor. Was the hotel-punched recipe.

name: Ferry Station Post Office Building (the Agriculture Building)

note: 1909 white terra-cotta flatiron with a rounded prow (Paff); three storeys, rusticated arched base, cornice and balustrade; not Club Fugazi
name: Fugazi Bank Building
Hotel VIA
note: notable.ts hotelVia_138_King (2026-10-16): two-storey glass lobby, ten room floors of terracotta with white-banded window strips, glass corner bays, a set-back mechanical floor with a roof terrace (owner + Mapillary).

name: Julius' Castle
note: 2026-10-16 from Commons: grey-green shingle castle restaurant, crenellated turret, battlements, lettering; was a Haiku terracotta tower
